Timing warning from the same page: 'Many Practica only accept new trainees at the beginning of the academic year (summer to early fall)... students should seek and establish a placement in a Practicum at least a year before graduation.' Practicum also requires passing a 'Practicum Readiness Review conducted by two WISR MFT faculty' after six named courses. Published length of study is 2-3 years full time, 6 years part time. No admissions test or GPA minimum is published — the stated admission requirement is a bachelor's degree plus an interview with the President or Chief Academic Officer.

The Counseling Program Administrative Assistant and the Field Placement Coordinator are available to assist you in finding a Practicum/Internship placement to begin CN/CM 530.

gre.evidence: A cumulative undergraduate GPA of 3.0 or higher

notes: Classified assisted because the seminary names a Field Placement Coordinator, publishes a list of pre-approved practicum/internship sites in the manual, and runs a site-approval process for sites not on that list — but the student does the finding. Caveat for prospective students: the San Jose Practicum/Internship Manual I could fetch is dated 2019, so its hour tables predate the current BBS rules; it splits hours as 40 direct client contact in practicum plus 240 across the three internship courses, and states 'A student pursuing the MFT license must earn at least 225 direct client contact' during Practicum/Internship, which conflicts with the 280 figure on the current programme page. The programme also requires 'a minimum of 30 hours of personal counseling.' The programme page's admission list makes no mention of the GRE.
